mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_order (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, allocation_id, attempt_id, owner_id, execution_authorization_id, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{allocationId}, #{attemptId}, #{ownerId}, #{authId}, #{status}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id

INSERT INTO outbound_line (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, order_id, order_line_id, sku_id, allocated_qty, picked_physical_qty, picked_posted_qty, packed_physical_qty, packed_posted_qty, shipped_physical_qty, shipped_posted_qty, cancelled_qty, base_unit, stock_sync_status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{orderId}, #{orderLineId}, #{skuId}, #{qty}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{unit}, 'PENDING', 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id

INSERT INTO outbound_task (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, task_type, document_id, document_line_id, source_location_id, target_location_id, planned_qty, completed_qty, state, assignee_id, claim_epoch, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{taskType}, #{documentId}, #{lineId}, #{sourceLocationId}, #{targetLocationId}, #{plannedQty}, 0, #{state}, NULL, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO outbound_package (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, order_id, package_no, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{orderId}, #{packageNo}, #{status}, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO package_line (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, package_id, outbound_line_id, qty, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{packageId}, #{lineId}, #{qty}, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT document_id FROM outbound_task WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND id=#{taskId}

SELECT id, document_id, document_line_id, source_location_id, target_location_id, planned_qty, state FROM outbound_task WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND planning_command_id=#{commandId}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_task SET planning_command_id=#{commandId} WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND id=#{taskId} AND planning_command_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_bucket_progress(enterprise_id,warehouse_id,line_id,location_id,lot_id, picked_posted_qty,shipped_physical_qty,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{enterpriseId},#{warehouseId},#{lineId},#{locationId},#{lotId},#{qty},0,0,#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE picked_posted_qty=picked_posted_qty+#{qty},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_line SET stock_sync_status=CASE WHEN picked_posted_qty=picked_physical_qty AND shipped_posted_qty=shipped_physical_qty AND cancelled_posted_qty=cancelled_qty THEN 'POSTED' ELSE 'PENDING' END WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND id=#{lineId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbound_cancellation WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND order_id=#{o}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_cancellation(enterprise_id,warehouse_id,attempt_id,cancellation_id,order_id,payload,payload_hash,state,next_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{r.e},#{r.w},#{r.a},#{r.id},#{r.o},CAST(#{r.payload} AS JSON),#{r.hash},'PROCESSING',#{r.now},#{r.now},#{r.now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempt_id=attempt_id
mapper.select: SELECT enterprise_id,warehouse_id,order_id FROM outbound_cancellation WHERE state='PROCESSING' AND next_at<=#{now} ORDER BY next_at,enterprise_id,warehouse_id,attempt_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_cancellation SET state=#{r.state},error_code=#{r.error,jdbcType=VARCHAR},next_at=#{r.next},version=version+1,updated_at=#{r.now} WHERE enterprise_id=#{r.e} AND warehouse_id=#{r.w} AND order_id=#{r.o} AND state='PROCESSING'

UPDATE source_command SET payload_json=JSON_SET(payload_json,'$.compensationId',#{id}) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND command_id=#{c} AND action='CANCEL' AND state='PENDING' AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(payload_json,'one','$.postingContext')
